One year programme funding support to ISS for the "Horn Center for Democracy Capacity Building Program: Inception Project".

Over the one-year duration of the inception project, HCD proposes to accomplish the following two objectives:
Objective 1: Build the capacity of the Center through; defining its internal structure, producing internal working documents and thematic base line studies that can serve as an input to the preparation of a strategic plan and main phase program document.
Objective 2: Program implementation with the aim of promoting and popularizing the center in the sub-region .
The major outcomes of this inception phase will be:
i. Center with a better internal steering and implementation capacity that is ready to effectively implement a bigger program during the subsequent program phase; and
ii. Center with a better networking outlook, convening power and popularity rate in the Horn of Africa Region.

The summative evaluation found that through this one year phase, HCD has achieved the key objectives, including organizational setup, baseline studies, and stakeholder engagement.
HCD's internal capacity building efforts have been instrumental in creating a foundational structure buttressed by comprehensive internal policies in financial, human resource, and risk management.
Furthermore, the thematic baseline studies conducted on governance, human rights, conflict sensitivity, and gender analysis have enhanced HCD's understanding of the complex democratic and governance challenges facing the Horn of Africa. These studies have also provided critical insights for programmatic planning and helped HCD to design interventions grounded in the sociopolitical realities of the region.
Through the hosting of a Regional Democracy Conference and the establishment of strategic partnerships, HCD has made considerable strides in network building.
